August 13, 2026 
 
To, 
The Listing Department 
BSE Limited, 
Phiroze Jeejeebhoy Towers, 
Dalal Street, 
Mumbai – 400001 
 
Scrip Code: 544587 
To, 
The Listing Department 
National Stock Exchange of India Limited, 
Exchange Plaza, 
Bandra Kurla Complex, Bandra (East), 
Mumbai – 400051 
 
Symbol: MIDWESTLTD 
 
Dear Sir / Madam, 
Subject: Audio Recording of Earnings Conference call for the Quarter ended June 30, 2026 
 
We wish to inform you that, pursuant to Regulation 30 and 46 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and 
Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, the audio recording of the Earnings Conference call 
held today i.e. Thursday, August 13, 2026 in relation to the Un-Audited standalone and consolidated 
financial results of the Company for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, have been uploaded on the 
website of the Company and can be accessed at the following link: 
 
https://midwest.in/static/9c3a6d9b3f7f8cf4e625aac21bf9db5b/Midwest_Q1FY27_Call_Audio.mp3 
 
 
Kindly take the same on record.  
 
Thanking you, 
 
Yours faithfully, 
For Midwest Limited 
 
 
 
K. Achyutanand Reddy  
 
 
                
 
 
Company Secretary 
Mem. No.: A44619 
 
 
 
Koppala 
Achyutanand Reddy
Digitally signed by Koppala 
Achyutanand Reddy 
Date: 2026.08.13 17:41:54 
+05'30'
